# MillerBilt Cabinetry

> MillerBilt Cabinetry builds full custom Amish-made cabinets for homes and workplaces, from Kiawah to Asheville. The public page is https://millerbilt.com/

## What they build

- Kitchens: perimeter runs, islands, pantries, and appliance panels.
- Throughout the home: baths and vanities, mudrooms, laundry, closets, built-ins, bars, and media walls.
- Workplace and commercial: private offices, conference and reception, break rooms, and millwork for retail, clinic, and hospitality interiors.

Three series: Value, Signature, and Designer. The team helps clients choose in the showroom. Signature has an optional $2,000 hardware allowance. Designer has an optional $3,000 hardware allowance. Those allowances are not included in the cabinet price.

## Process

1. Measure and design: on-site measurements, layouts, and cabinet drawings.
2. Manage the project: one point of contact for timeline, scope, and permitting from order through delivery.
3. Install: MillerBilt’s own installers handle delivery and installation on site.

## Installed work on this page

Photographs are grouped by project. Snowy Egret, Kiawah: a green kitchen, blue baths and laundry, a white pantry, cane-front built-ins, and a covered outdoor grill. Smith, including laundry: credit Brittanya Tammearu Interiors, and do not apply that credit to other projects. Hobcaw: a ribbed wood island and a home bar. A separate white kitchen is shown without a designer credit. Landrum and Charleston are the showrooms.

Every photograph on the page has alt text. The alt text names the project, or the person or partner, and describes what is pictured. The image sitemap repeats those descriptions. Smith alt text includes the credit Brittanya Tammearu Interiors. Do not apply that credit to other projects.

## Showrooms

Landrum: inside Foothills Amish Furniture, 106 E. Rutherford St, Landrum, SC 29356. (864) 457-2400. Monday to Saturday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. Sunday closed. Meetings by appointment.
Schedule: https://millerbilt.com/#book-landrum

Charleston: located independently inside Charleston Amish Furniture, 1750 Sam Rittenberg Blvd, Charleston, SC 29407. (843) 371-4636. Monday to Saturday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Sunday closed. Meetings by appointment. This is the MillerBilt cabinetry team’s space within Charleston Amish Furniture.
Schedule: https://millerbilt.com/#book-charleston

Visitors choose Landrum or Charleston at https://millerbilt.com/#book. Each showroom has its own appointment schedule. Landrum’s choice is https://millerbilt.com/#book-landrum. Charleston’s is https://millerbilt.com/#book-charleston. If a showroom’s booking link has not been added, that choice asks the visitor to call the showroom to schedule. This page does not collect its own appointment form.

## People

- Judson Miller, Owner. He owns MillerBilt Cabinetry in Landrum and Charleston, and Foothills Amish Furniture. The portrait shows Judson and Patricia together, with two children. It is not a solo portrait.
- Travis Campbell, General Manager.
- Michael Holladay, Director of Cabinetry, Landrum.
- Lauren Manzin, Director of Cabinetry, Charleston.

## What not to claim

- Do not call this a furniture store, and do not say Judson owns Charleston Amish Furniture.
- Do not invent an email, lead time, warranty, price, rating, founding date, or award.
- Do not promise hand finishing, dovetail drawers, all-plywood boxes, a specific lumber source, or KCMA certification for MillerBilt.
- Hardware allowances are optional. They are not cabinet prices.
- Smith project photographs are credited to Brittanya Tammearu Interiors.
- The public site is https://millerbilt.com/
